title: Hydrazineyl-linked imidazole[1,2-a]pyrimidine-thiazole hybrids: design, synthesis, and in vitro biological evaluation studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32477-32496
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04692K, Paper

Dinesha P, Shivakumar Naik, Udayakumar D, Revanasiddappa B. C, Venkatesh Ranjan, Naveena S. Veeranagaiah
A new set of imidazo[1,2-a]pyrimidine-thiazole hybrids were developed through a molecular hybridization concept. Three compounds exhibited potent anti-TB activity with MIC of 1.6 μg mL−1.
